qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 8fd47e7 and serialized fix rechecks of 82b1d3b found the original consistency, quiz-safety and comprehensibility defects resolved; correctness was clean from the start. 訓's first example now gives the reading of 山 in kana (やま) instead of the Cyrillic respelling «яма»; 記事 no longer explains itself through the English letters a and the, a warning about the English homonym article that does not apply to Russian «статья»; 試し's first example translation now reads «Я на пробу воспользовался этим приложением, чтобы посмотреть, что оно собой представляет.» Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 17 EN exclusions across 13 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 21 direct, one-sided exclusions on 16 new cards: 生まれ–生まれる; 誕生–生まれる; 許す–許可; 認める–承認/許可; 試し–試験; 判断–読み; 評価–読み; 検査–調査/テスト; 診察–受付; 設計–案; 訪問–訪ねる/伺う/お見舞い; 記憶–覚える/思い出す; 記念–記憶; 訓–読み; 討つ–勝つ; 触れる–関する. Two were added after review: 訪問–お見舞い and 判断–読み. 認める's title was reworded during authoring from «признавать; обнаруживать» to «признавать; замечать» to avoid an exact segment overlap with 見つける; «замечать» is shared with 気付く, which EN already guards. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.
